answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**：三种相邻构造：四个平台的等高百分比堆叠柱，带柱内数值、图例和平台标志；按 Twitter、Facebook 分组的无轴国家排名名单；五地区横向分组条，带灰色满宽轨道、上方图例及条端数值。

**定位一个值难在哪**：右图的 49% 必须同时用“Politics”和“Africa”定位；五条相邻同色序列只由上方共享图例命名。9%还在左图 TikTok 柱中重复出现。

**不确定的**：中间国家名单可能是左图的附属面板，而非独立图；其两组分别有五、六行。灰色轨道按背景处理，未计入数据标记。

heading.title: PROPORTION WHO THINK THEY SEE TOO MUCH NEWS
heading.subtitle: ON EACH NETWORK – UK

worked_example.why_hard: A thin segment shares each stack with three other response bands.
Repeated 21% values require the country label to distinguish rows.

heading.title: PROPORTION WHO SAW FALSE OR MISLEADING
heading.subtitle:
INFORMATION ABOUT EACH TOPIC IN THE LAST WEEK –
SELECTED REGIONS

worked_example.why_hard: Wrapped topic text and the shared legend identify one of five adjacent bars.

components.evidence: Four response segments are stacked within each network bar.
All network stacks have equal height; printed segment percentages total approximately 100%.
Only a baseline and category labels appear; percentages are printed inside segments.
“Too much”, “About right”, “Not enough”, and “Don’t know” sit below the bars.
Percentages including “21%”, “55%”, and “3%” are printed inside coloured segments.
“Q12_Social_rightsize ... Base:” is printed in small type below the visual.
Twitter and Facebook repeat the same ranked market-row layout.
“Twitter” and “Facebook” head the two ranked sections.
The “Q12_Social_rightsize ... Base:” line spans below the adjacent ranked list.
Each topic contains five separate regional bars.
Topic labels sit left while all bars extend horizontally right.
No numerical value ticks are drawn; every percentage is printed at a bar end.
The five-region legend sits between the heading and the COVID-19 bars.
Labels such as “49%” and “9%” sit just beyond the coloured bar ends.
“Climate change” and “Products (e.g. scams)” are wrapped onto two lines.
“Q. FAKE_NEWS 2021a.”, “Base:”, and “Note:” appear below the plot.

answer.hardest_step_why: 49%需同时关联“Politics”和“Africa”；9%又跨图重复，直印数值仍最难在标签关联。负担最高。相邻条和共享图例使得单独的数值不足以定位。需要主题与地区两个键，且中间排名名单还增加面板与国家层级。由于数值都直接打印，精度并非主要问题；最可能失败的是把图例、类别与具体单元格正确关联。这里49%在Politics的Africa条，9%在Immigration的Asia条，但9%也出现在左侧TikTok的Too much段，若缺少完整键会误配。跨图重复和共享图例共同增加步骤3的风险。即使表中包含数值，也必须保存原页标签层级。最难的是关联，不是读取。

examples.quote: 21%, 55%, 3%, and 20% are printed inside the Facebook stack.
examples.why: 需控制堆叠段内数值位置，并在极薄色带中保持可读。
同一国家排名构造分成两个网络面板，面板名必须进入键。

examples.quote: PROPORTION WHO SAW FALSE OR MISLEADING / INFORMATION ABOUT EACH TOPIC IN THE LAST WEEK – / SELECTED REGIONS
examples.why: 标题需拆成主标题、续行，并保留其位于图例和绘图区上方的位置。

examples.quote: Every coloured bar overlays a full-width light-grey track; percentages sit beyond coloured ends.
examples.why: 需生成灰色轨道及条外百分比，而不是默认坐标轴读数。

examples.quote: Each market row begins with a national flag icon and ends with a percentage.
examples.why: 现有变化未覆盖无轴排名名单及国旗、文本、右对齐数值的行式组合。
